name: hilbish.runner
description:
The runner interface contains functions that allow the user to change
how Hilbish interprets interactive input.
Users can add and change the default runner for interactive input to any
language or script of their choosing. A good example is using it to
write commands in Fennel.


A runner is a table with `run` and `validate` functions; see the
`Runner` type below. `run` returns a `RunnerResult`, also detailed below.


Here is a simple example of a fennel runner. It falls back to
shell script if fennel eval has an error.


```lua
local fennel = require 'fennel'


hilbish.runner.add('fennel', {
	run = function(input)
		local ok = pcall(fennel.eval, input)
		if ok then
			return { input = input }
		end
		return hilbish.runner.sh(input)
	end,
	validate = function(input)
		return someMethodUsedToCheckIfFennelInputIsFinished(input)
	end,
})
hilbish.runner.setCurrent('fennel')
```

types.name: Runner
description: A table describing how to run and validate interactive input for a runner mode.

properties.name: run
description: Evaluates the input and returns a result table.

properties.name: validate
description: Checks whether the input is complete and ready to run. Return `false` to prompt the user for more input (continuation), or `true` to proceed.

types.name: RunnerResult
description: The table returned by a `Runner`'s `run` function. All fields are optional;
only set the ones relevant to the runner (if there isn't an error, just omit `err`).

properties.name: exitCode
description: Exit code of the command.

properties.name: input
description: The text input of the user. Used by Hilbish to append extra input if more is requested.

properties.name: err
description: A string that represents an error from the runner. This should only be set on syntax errors. It can be set to a few special values for Hilbish to throw the right hooks and show a better looking message: `<command>: not-found` will throw a `command.not-found` hook, `<command>: not-executable` will throw a `command.not-executable` hook.

properties.name: continue
description: Whether Hilbish should prompt the user for more input.

properties.name: newline
description: Whether a newline should be added at the end of `input`.

docs.name: add
description: Adds a runner to the table of available runners. Errors if a runner
with `name` already exists. Use `set` to overwrite an existing runner.

docs.name: exec
description: Runs `cmd` using the named runner, or the current runner if `runnerName` is not given.

params.Name: runnerName
Doc: The name of the runner to use. Defaults to the current runner.

docs.name: get
description: Get a runner by name. Throws an error if the runner does not exist.

params.Name: name
Doc: Name of the runner to retrieve.

docs.name: getCurrent
description: Returns the name of the currently active runner.

returns.Name: name
Doc: The name of the current runner.

docs.name: lua
description: Evaluates `input` as Lua code. Equivalent to `load(input)()`, shaped
for the runner interface.

docs.name: run
description: Runs `input` with the currently set Hilbish runner.
This method is how Hilbish executes commands.
`priv` is an optional boolean used to state if the input should be saved to history.

docs.name: set
description: Sets (or replaces) a runner by name, without checking if one already exists.

params.Name: name
Doc: Name of the runner to set.

docs.name: setCurrent
description: Sets Hilbish's active runner mode by name. Errors if the runner does not exist.

params.Name: name
Doc: Name of the runner to make active.

docs.name: sh
description: Runs `input` as a shell script using Hilbish's built-in shell interpreter.
